name: Nagatsuki Heinojou
source:
A loyal gentleman who serves the Kannazuki family. As Aoi's de facto personal butler, he appears out of nowhere in an impressive 0.3 seconds whenever Aoi calls him. He also provides significant support to the Twin Angels.

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character6.html]official site[/url]]
